description: The file appears to be a PHP source file that implements a class interface for Jira REST API interactions within a test linking project. It includes setup for connection parameters, instantiates a Jira API interface object, and performs various calls to retrieve issue types, priorities, versions, and components from Jira, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: jirarestInterface
classes.description: A class interface to interact with Jira REST API endpoints, providing methods to fetch issue types, priorities, versions, and components, and manage connection status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the jirarestInterface object with configuration data, setting up connection parameters.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the connection to Jira REST API is successful.

methods.name: getIssueTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available issue types from Jira for the configured project.

methods.name: getIssueTypesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Fetches issue types formatted for HTML select elements.

methods.name: getPriorities
methods.description: Retrieves the list of issue priorities from Jira.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Fetches project versions from Jira by project key.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components associated with a Jira project.
